rationale: The blind translation accurately reconstructs the scalar expressions appearing on the right side of (4.32) and the matrix infinity-norm factors, but it turns those expressions into newly named exact quantities and proves only definitional arithmetic relationships among them. The paper instead gives an order-level normwise forward-error bound for a specific scaled, mixed-precision p-word matrix multiplication algorithm, together with a no-range comparator and qualitative discussion. Because neither statement semantically implies the other as presented, the translation is not-faithful-different.
